behaviour_summary: pi0 grasps the standing book by its upper edge; the book swings to horizontal in the gripper; pi0 lowers it over the middle column of the caddy but it cannot enter, then lifts it back out and holds it in the air until the timeout.

failures.mode_definition: The object is grasped off-centre at one edge and rotates in the gripper during lift, so it arrives at the destination in an orientation that cannot be inserted or placed.
failures.rl_subtask: pick(book) with a stable upright grasp and place it in the back compartment of the caddy
failures.rl_success_check: book inside the back compartment of the caddy, gripper open
failures.observation: Step 80 the open gripper is above the upright book; at 100-120 it closes on the book's top edge and lifts; at 140 the book is tilted ~45-90 degrees and at 160 it is held horizontally like a flag. 160-280 the gripper descends over the middle/back of the caddy with the book flat across the dividers at rim height; 300-340 it lifts the book back out; 340-409 the book is held high, never released.

notes: The book is black against the black compartment interiors, so whether its lower edge entered the back compartment at 220-280 is uncertain; it is clearly out again by 340. The retract-without-release at ~300 may be an HL abort after a failed insertion, but I treat it as a consequence of the misoriented grasp. Same initial layout as task78_fail_init0, same behaviour.
